descriptor: Account app whose settings stay simple and visible

voice.summary: A calm admin voice: clear labels, neutral tone and no surprises. It explains consequences before you click and confirms afterwards.
dos: Confirm saved changes with a single sentence
donts: Playful jokes next to account deletion

taglines: Everything you can change, in plain sight
boilerplate: Plainsight is an account platform whose settings pages group profile, notifications, appearance, security and billing in one clear, reversible place.

microcopy.error: That email looks invalid. Check and retry
microcopy.empty: No notifications set. Choose what to hear

logo.note: A clean diamond suggests clarity, like a lens, and stays neutral for a settings brand.
